# Security policy

[日本語](SECURITY.ja.md)

FlintEye is **under development**, with no stable public release yet. Security fixes target the current public source and subsequent previews. Older private testing builds are not supported public releases.

Please use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/noguhiro2002/FlintEye/security/advisories/new) to contact the maintainer privately. Include the affected version/commit, OS, reproduction steps, expected impact and a minimal example using synthetic data. If the private form is unavailable, request a private contact route in Discussions without disclosing the vulnerability.

Do not post passwords, API keys, setup tokens, private camera addresses or footage. Test only systems you own or are authorized to assess. Please allow time to investigate before publishing exploit details; no guaranteed response deadline is offered.

For ordinary UI defects or installation problems, use [Issues](https://github.com/noguhiro2002/FlintEye/issues). See [server deployment](../docs/DISTRIBUTION.md) for LAN access and HTTPS configuration.
